핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

미국 경제가 역사적 전례를 찾기 어려울 만큼 높은 불확실성에 처해 있다는 BofA의 진단이 나온 가운데, 글로벌 통화 불안도 가시화되고 있다. ING는 일본의 외환 개입이 이제 시작 단계에 불과하다고 경고하며 엔화 약세 압력이 당분간 지속될 수 있음을 시사했다. 이러한 대외 불안 속에서 국내에서는 연내 금리를 두 차례 인상하는 시나리오가 기본 전제로 굳어지는 분위기이며, 시장의 핵심 과제는 기대인플레이션 상승을 선제적으로 차단하는 것으로 모아지고 있다. 부동산 시장에서는 규제 부담으로 인해 수도권과 지방 간 양극화가 심화되는 조짐이 나타나고 있으며, 국토연구원은 주택 중심으로 편중된 자산 구조가 국가 전체의 생산성에도 부정적인 영향을 미친다고 지적했다. 결국 오늘의 경제 흐름은 **대외 불확실성 확대 → 통화·금리 긴축 압력 강화 → 자산시장 내 불균형 심화**라는 연결 고리로 요약된다.

top5_headlines.summary: 이달 29.6조 순매도…월 최대 예고 국내 증시 시총 비중은 40% 육박 이란發 금리발작, 차익실현 가능성 금융당국선 “금리인상 여력 커져” 이달 들어 외국인이 국내 주식을 30조원 가까이 순매도했지만, 국장 내 외국인 비중은 오히려 늘었다. 대규모 매도 이상으로 외국인들의 주식 가치가 더 올랐기 때문이다.

top5_headlines.title: 주담대 금리 상단 7% 돌파 … 은행 원리금 한달 새 ‘ 껑충 ’
top5_headlines.summary: 전쟁 장기화에 美국채 금리 급등 영향 변동형 대출 이자부담 더 늘어날 듯 중동 정세 장기화에 따른 인플레이션 우려로 미국 국채 금리가 급등하면서 대출 차주들의 이자 부담 증가 우려가 커지고 있다. 사진은 서울 강남구 한 부동산 중개업소와 은행 현금자동지급기 모습.  [연합] #. 내 집 마련 막차를 타기 위해 대출을 알아보던 직장인 김 모 씨.

sections.Hot Economy News: The global economy faces mounting pressures as inflation concerns intensify and geopolitical tensions affect energy markets. The US experiences strong inflation data with April PPI rising 6% year-over-year, while China shows mixed economic signals with 5.2% unemployment but modest consumer price increases. Bank of America warns of unprecedented economic chaos, reflecting broader concerns among Wall Street analysts about sustained high interest rates and their cascading effects on various sectors and markets.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: China's economic recovery shows warning signs as both consumption and industrial output display hesitation, despite the government reaffirming its commitment to economic defense. South Korea faces jobless growth concerns, with 30-year-olds experiencing elevated unemployment at over 3% for five consecutive months, driven by long-term youth unemployment extending into their thirties. Japan's 1Q GDP growth of 0.5% (2.1% annualized) exceeded expectations and marks two consecutive quarters of expansion, supporting potential interest rate increases. Discussions on fiscal policy flexibility continue, with arguments that Korea has room for expansionary spending relative to international standards.
sections.Financial Markets: Global bond markets experience significant selling pressure as US Treasury yields rise amid inflation concerns, with the 30-year yield reaching 5.16%, the highest since October 2023. Wall Street bond king Jeffrey Gundlach predicts rate cuts are virtually impossible this year and forecasts CPI reaching the 4% range. New ETF products continue launching, including bond-focused funds targeting mid-term corporate bonds. Equity markets remain volatile, with Samsung semiconductor stocks rebounding on strike resolution hopes while other high-interest-sensitive sectors like automotive and electronics suffer sharp declines.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector leads market movements with Samsung strike risks moderating, though broader industrial weakness affects automotive and consumer electronics companies under pressure from elevated borrowing costs. Specialized inspection equipment manufacturer Secq emerges as a key beneficiary across semiconductor, defense, and battery industries with high-resolution non-destructive testing demand. EMT, a battery materials company, wins major awards for EV battery technology and supply chain expansion, positioning itself for structural growth as electric vehicle markets expand. LG Energy Solution partners with Honda and Hanoi city to build battery exchange stations for electric two-wheelers across Vietnam.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market shows signs of triple strength with simultaneous increases in sales prices, jeonse (long-term leases), and monthly rentals, though the overall market remains seller-favorable. Critical jeonse shortage emerges in Seoul metropolitan areas, with monthly rent index reaching record highs at 109, while long-term lease availability virtually disappears in some large developments. Government regulations on jeonse lending and broad restrictions create market rigidity, with one apartment complex of 700 units having only one jeonse listing available. Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song plans to dispose of 2 of 3 properties, including an office-tel sale completed in April, amid property management questions.
sections.International Economy: Kevin Warsh assumes Federal Reserve Chair duties on May 22 amid significant pressure from President Trump to cut interest rates, with his first FOMC meeting scheduled for mid-June. The US housing market faces direct impact from elevated mortgage rates driven by geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns, as bond yields surge. Energy shocks from Middle East conflicts trigger broad inflation worries across global markets, with major developed economies experiencing simultaneous bond selloffs. The political environment creates uncertainty as the new Fed leadership navigates between market expectations for rate cuts and inflation control imperatives.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's business community emphasizes the need for labor market flexibility paired with enhanced employment safety nets as AI and digital transformation rapidly reshape industrial employment structures. Google partners with Blackstone to establish a new AI cloud company with initial $5 billion investment and potential $250 billion in computing infrastructure, directly challenging Nvidia's dominance in AI infrastructure. Jensen Huang expresses optimism about eventual Chinese market access for advanced AI chips despite current export restrictions. Mashup Ventures invests in AI consulting firm Orbit Korea, which provides data-driven growth strategies for consumer brands expanding internationally. Meta accelerates workforce restructuring with 8,000 employee layoffs despite leading AI infrastructure investments.
sections.Others: Hyundai Motor Group's Boston Dynamics division showcases advanced humanoid robot Atlas performing complex logistics tasks with impressive dexterity, handling 45kg loads and executing complex movements. M83 accelerates development of AI-based VFX production solution Diclops through subsidiary DeblueAI, achieving significant cost and time reductions in content creation. Financial Supervisory Service Chair warns about dangers of leveraged debt investment and leverage-conditioned ETFs ahead of single-stock leverage ETF launch. Local government candidates propose agricultural policy transformation, with plans to cultivate 1,000 high-income farms and increase agricultural budget allocation to 25%.
